build_task_physics_scene: build a physics simulation task with a jar, obstacle bars, and a ball using the PHYRE creator library
create_dynamic_jar: create a dynamic jar object centered at 50% scene width with scale 0.2 at the bottom of the scene
add_static_bar_obstacle: add a static bar obstacle at a specified angle and position to block object movement in the scene
define_spatial_relationship_task: define a task goal requiring a ball to be placed inside a jar using spatial relationships and phantom vertices
configure_ball_position: configure a dynamic ball object at the center of the scene width and 90% of scene height
